messages:
maya: Quick bench update — brought up llamaX-13B int8 and fp16 across three pops (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Observed surprising p95 divergence in eu-west; looks correlated with an extra edge hop + proxy path. Trying to collect numbers and kernel traces.

liam: Can you drop the p50/p95 + config? especially kernel and batch settings.

maya: Paste of the run from the canary (steady-state, batch=1):
```
region   GPU   quant   batch   p50_ms   p95_ms   tok/s   kernel
us-east  H100  int8    1       44       205     1520    flash-attn-v2
us-west  A100  int8    1       50       310     1380    open-fused-attn
eu-west  H100  int8    1       47       690     1490    flash-attn-v2 + edge-proxy-2 hop

Fallback (fp16) eu-west p95 drops to ~260ms (still higher than us regions)
```
Notes: eu-west p95 only spikes on ~10% of requests; traces show additional ~420ms spent in `edge-proxy-2` TLS handshake + queuing when routed through that POP.

anita: Was the model warmed / KV cache hit-rate similar across pops? Could be cold-KV warmup noise.

maya: Warm caches for the test (we primed with 200 requests). KV hit-rate > 98% in all regions. The tail aligns with timeouts/queueing on proxy: stack traces show `proxy:conn_wait` at top of span for tailing requests. Sample curl of a slow trace: 
```
# trace snippet
POST /v1/llm/generate 200 ms server process
edge-proxy-2: conn_wait 420 ms
server: model_infer 200 ms
```

kevin: Hmm. Two levers: 1) routing policy — avoid edge-proxy-2 for low-latency routes, 2) kernel/quant fallback — if int8 on eu-west causes more CPU overhead in proxy path, fallback to fp16 for that pop. We can A/B quickly.

liam: Also try forcing `kernel=flash-attn-v1` vs v2 — we saw a different event-loop interaction on v2 + proxy earlier. Worth testing a kernel-only canary before changing routing.

maya: Will run both. Quick plan:
- run kernel-only canary (weight 5%) in eu-west forcing flash-attn-v1 and compare p95 over 30m
- run routing tweak: reduce route weight to edge-proxy-2 in eu-west (temp)
- test fp16 fallback for eu-west int8 canary if kernel doesn't help

deploy-bot: canary:route-update submitted by @maya — eu-west edge-proxy-2 weight -> 0.1 for 30m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sre-bot: FYI alerted on increased p95 in eu-west; creating postmortem if p95 > 500ms sustained for 15m.

anita: One more ask — add perf counters for `proxy->tls_handshake` and `proxy->queue_time` in the next canary so we can attribute.

kevin: Agreed. If kernel-only fixes reduce p95 < 300ms, no routing change. If not, routing fallback + fp16. Also update capacity sizing note: with fallback to fp16 we lose ~12% throughput; record that for capacity planning.

maya: Action items assigned:
- @liam to run kernel canary (flash-attn-v1) and post results (30m)
- @maya to run routing weight change (already submitted) and run fp16 fallback test if needed
- @anita to add the proxy perf counters to canary metrics
- @kevin to update capacity spreadsheet with fp16 throughput delta

liam: I'll drop initial numbers in 35m.

maya: Thanks — keeping this thread as the single place for traces and quick dumps. :thumbsup:
